title: malariafwd: Forward Simulation of Plasmodium vivax Transmission and Genetics
description: An R interface to a SLiM (Eidos) + tskit individual-based forward simulator of Plasmodium vivax malaria. Models blood-stage infection, the hypnozoite reservoir and relapses, meiotic recombination in the mosquito, and importation/interventions on a neutral 14-chromosome PvP01 genome, recording a tree sequence for ground-truth identity-by-descent.
